title: Manorama Industries Limited (NSE: MANORAMA) — Specialty Fats & CBE Compounder Underwriting Dossier
primer: Manorama Industries is India’s largest producer of Cocoa Butter Equivalents (CBE) and exotic tree-borne specialty fats. Our price-blind audit grades the business COMPOUNDER_PASS with a working-capital watch on its 369-day seasonal inventory cycle. At ₹1,984.10 on November 13, 2026, the stock sits in a Stage 2 uptrend, but a -5.52% selloff on 2.83x 30D volume alongside 6 distribution days in 25 sessions and -6.62% 28-day relative strength warrants patience. We assign WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT in the ₹1,870–₹1,960 shelf (stop ₹1,664, base target ₹2,520, 1.89:1 support asymmetry) while holding existing shares.
holding_rationale: You hold 85 shares in Zerodha at an average cost of ₹1,854.17 (market value ₹1,68,648.50, +7.01% gain, 3.92% portfolio weight). That size sits well below our 1% portfolio risk-budget ceiling of 145 shares. With Q2 FY27 revenue up 41.9% YoY and the Stage 2 trend intact, we recommend KEEP_COMPOUNDING with zero shares sold and a hard weekly stop at ₹1,664.

destinations.entry_condition: No immediate deployment; revisit only on >15% pullback or ROCE inflection.
